item.content:encoded:
I guess you could still interpret it that way. I just think the Foundation doesn't anticipate unflinching loyalty most of the time, and keeps most things on a need-to-know.

Yeah, and that's a line that covert operations have to walk all the time, but keeping mission critical information, especially since its something they might figure out tends to be really bad for long term loyalty, and moles are the biggest threat to covert ops, always.

It's not totally implausible that they'd be in the dark, but it might have been better if the story continued into how Sherry reacts to finding out. Especially given that she is probably already thinking of following Hans, but doesn't. I think any of the possible reactions by Sherry, and Mr. Glass' response to that would have clarified this loose end for me.
